title: The First Compact
body: Signed in iron and tallow between border lords and exiled dwarven smith-clans, the Compact bound each province to maintain the mountain drainage galleries (see cdx-undervault-galleries) and weather-wards. Three centuries of tax-skimming reduced the treaty to rotted vellum.
unlock_hint: Inspect the boundary stone at Sunken Ford.

title: The Salt Tithe
body: An emergency wartime levy drafted by High Quartermaster Morvessa (see cdx-morvessa-ledger) to strip northern border parishes of brine, grain, and iron ore. Clerks weighed salt on apothecary scales while watchmen starved on promissory slips.
unlock_hint: Find a Border Mint tax writ in Act I.

title: The Climate Wardstones
body: Twelve primeval quartz monoliths driven into the Redmarsh plateau (see cdx-plateau-spires) to anchor rain-clouds and pin alkali dust below the highland passes. When blood-chanters cracked three spires, hot grit drifted north within hours.
unlock_hint: Examine a ruptured wardstone in m16.

title: Third-Dynasty Probate Law
body: Before the inland sea evaporated into Redmarsh, coastal magistrates ruled that unpaid tax liens survive death. Crypt Embalmers (see cdx-crypt-embalmers) still enforce those decrees with bitumen jars and bone hooks.
unlock_hint: Recover a funerary tablet in Redmarsh.

title: The Age of Chains
body: An era of geo-sorcery when border kings bound living bedrock into Elder Juggernauts (see cdx-elder-juggernauts) to patrol mountain passes without wages or rations. Most rusted into scree; a few still wake when ley-currents surge.
unlock_hint: Defeat an Elder Juggernaut in Act III.

title: The Whale-Oil Charter
body: Oakhaven's merchant guild grew rich refining lamp oil for Harborwatch's great lighthouse (see cdx-harborwatch-mole). When war closed the straits, privateers hoarded the casks as naval incendiaries.
unlock_hint: Inspect a burned pier in Harborwatch.

title: The Anchor Seals
body: Seven meteoric-iron valves sunk into the caldera floor to bleed primordial magma pressure away from the upper provinces. First Warden Ashkarath (see cdx-ashkarath-watch) starved the realm of warmth rather than risk unbinding them.
unlock_hint: Read an Anchor Seal inscription in Act IV.

title: The Crown of Order
body: Forged from fallen star-iron and quenched in alpine snow, the diadem was meant to bind sovereigns to the soil's health. Chronicler Zahra's rubbings suggest it began as a collar of servitude.
unlock_hint: Decipher the Threshold silver door.

title: The Primordial Ember
body: The unquenched furnace beneath the Obsidian Throne (see cdx-obsidian-dais). It offers strength enough to reshape Thornvael's climate, yet burns away every memory not anchored by iron will.
unlock_hint: Approach the molten seal in m44.

title: Arcane Thermodynamics
body: Expelled Capital Collegium scholars proved that invocation syllables act as pressure valves on ambient ley-currents. Misfires occur not from divine wrath, but from damp chalk and sloppy grounding.
unlock_hint: Speak with a mage hero or Zahra.

title: Mortuary Debt-Rolls
body: Among border abbeys, necromancy is practiced as strict probate bookkeeping: summoning dead debtors to finish unfulfilled oaths before granting final rest.
unlock_hint: Witness a spirit binding in combat.

title: The Caldera Schism
body: When Arch-Mage Malrik (see cdx-malrik-defection) traded his sight to read volcanic veins, half the Crown College followed him south, preferring eternal ash to growing cold in northern towers.
unlock_hint: Collect Malrik's syllabus cylinders.

title: Thornwick Market
body: A mud-walled river town straddling three peat roads and a timber toll-bridge (see cdx-alder-span). Its plank palisades bristle with sharpened stakes while merchants weigh grain behind shuttered stalls.
unlock_hint: Enter Thornwick Market in Act I.

title: Alder Bridge
body: Three-century-old oak-and-stone crossing spanning the swollen Alder River. Sole artery wide enough for wheeled artillery between Thornwick and the high moors.
unlock_hint: Defend Alder Bridge in m08.

title: The Undervault Links
body: Three miles of ventilated dwarven stone tunnels cut beneath the northern granite ridge during the First Compact (see cdx-first-compact). Damp mortar and lead-sealed armories line its dark galleries.
unlock_hint: Descend into the Undervault in m10.

title: Ashbrook Gatehouse
body: Southern hinge of the Border Fords frontier, reduced to smoldering timber and turnip-field graves when Velen's rams broke the outer bars.
unlock_hint: Survive the retreat at Ashbrook.

title: Redmarsh Stockade
body: A sinking timber-and-earth fort braced on oak pilings above rust-red alkali silt. Water sells by the gill while leeches fatten in the stagnant moat.
unlock_hint: Arrive at Redmarsh Outpost in Act II.

title: The Quartz Plateau
body: Wind-scoured alkali mesa crowned by primeval climate wardstones (see cdx-wardstone-lattice). Static discharge turns exposed steel blue before desert squalls strike.
unlock_hint: Climb the Quartz Plateau in m16.

title: The Deep Quarry
body: A four-hundred-foot terraced pit sunk into a volcanic fault for dense black ironstone. Flooded at the bottom with black rainwater and ringed by rusted slave-cranes.
unlock_hint: Liberate the quarry terraces in m20.

title: Ironheart Bastion
body: Black-slag fortress crowning twin volcanic spires above sinking salt-bogs and cannon-swept causeways. Controls the sole mountain pass to the Iron Coast.
unlock_hint: Storm Ironheart Bastion in m23.

title: Oakhaven Bastion
body: Walled hill-city anchored around petrified cedar pilings where the Greywash meets the sea. Slate roofs, guild curfew bells, and drydocks smelling of pine pitch.
unlock_hint: Enter Oakhaven in Act III.

title: The Sunken Citadel
body: First-Empire sea-stack fortress tilted ten cubits into the Atlantic swell. Spring tides flood its lower barbican twice daily, trapping armored men in kelp-slick halls.
unlock_hint: Breach the water-gate in m28.

title: Harborwatch Anchorage
body: Deep-water port guarded by bronze sea-wall culverins and a whale-oil lighthouse visible for forty leagues. Torched during Admiral Kael's blockade.
unlock_hint: Retake the seawall batteries in m35.

title: The Obsidian Dais
body: Geometric basalt sanctuary at the exact center of the volcanic caldera, split by magma moats and crowned by the glass throne of the First Emperors.
unlock_hint: Reach the Threshold Chamber in m44.

title: Thornwick Border Levy
body: Underpaid provincial pikemen and bridge-wardens commanded by Sergeant Garrick (see cdx-garrick-watch). Stubborn in mud trenches, chronically short of crossbow bolts and dry boots.
unlock_hint: Speak with Sergeant Garrick.

title: The Salt-Tithe Commission
body: Armed tax-bailiffs, ledger-clerks, and arson-companies organized by Morvessa to foreclose on border granaries and iron mines.
unlock_hint: Clashes with bailiffs in Act I.

title: The Ashen Coven
body: Renegade hedge-mages and blood-chanters led by Mordred and Hexer Saelen who tap subterranean ley-fissures to rot crops and animate drowned corpses.
unlock_hint: Discover Mordred's altar in m04.

title: Redmarsh Sand-Clans
body: Nomadic dune-raiders riding wind-scoured arroyos with horn-bows and curved scimitars. Armed with contraband Deep Quarry iron to bleed northern supply trains.
unlock_hint: Repel a canyon ambush in Act II.

title: Oakhaven Merchant Council
body: Wealthy timber-barons and tower-adepts who tax both smugglers and royal galleys, hoarding salt-beef behind bolted gates until the blockade threatens their drydocks.
unlock_hint: Negotiate entry at Oakhaven.

title: The Ironclad Banner
body: A mercenary host of coastal pike-men stitched under rust-dyed sailcloth. Loyal strictly to weighed silver and quick to turn on employers who pay in clipped tin.
unlock_hint: Encounter the Ironclads in m34.

title: The Ashen Company
body: Rival sellswords recruited from burned fishing towns along the Iron Coast, locked in bloody turf wars with the Ironclad Banner over harbor salvage.
unlock_hint: Break the rival banners in m34.

title: Vesperion's Black Fleet
body: Copper-sheeted war galleys and fire-hulks commanded by Lord Admiral Vesperion to burn coastal shipyards and prevent armies from crossing to the caldera.
unlock_hint: Fight marine boarders in Act III.

title: Ironcamp Forge-Guild
body: Keloid-scarred smiths and siege-sappers led by Forgemaster Vok who quench meteoric steel in open caldera fissures.
unlock_hint: Visit Vok's forge in Ironcamp.

title: The Scorched Penitents
body: Blind battle-mages and ash-robed archivists following Brother Elias, bearing iron collars to atone for opening the caldera's first cinder-gates.
unlock_hint: Speak with Brother Elias.

title: The First Watch
body: Ancient wardens who sealed the volcanic threshold centuries ago. Many remain bound to obsidian pillars as unquiet witnesses awaiting formal discharge.
unlock_hint: Find a First Watch plate in Act IV.

title: Dread Vanguard of the Throne
body: Meteor-plated champions and magma-forged constructs guarding the Gauntlet of Iron and the Anchor Seals under First Warden Ashkarath.
unlock_hint: Face a Dread Knight in Act IV.

title: Briar Hound
body: Feral border curs colonized by parasitic iron-bramble growing directly through their ribs. Hunt in starving packs along river shallows; vulnerable to fire.
unlock_hint: Slay Briar Hounds at the Sunken Ford.

title: Flintback
body: Quarry-beasts whose dorsal hides calcified into overlapping slabs of grey chert. Arrows glance off; crack their posture with heavy mauls or lightning.
unlock_hint: Encounter a Flintback in Act I.

title: Mire Wisp
body: Pockets of marsh methane and spiteful lingering memory anchored inside drowned livestock skulls. Disperse them with fire before corpse-gas chokes the vanguard.
unlock_hint: Survive a fen ambush in m02.

title: Dune Lurker
body: Ochre-shelled desert mantids buried up to their eyes in dry creek beds. Erupt behind stragglers with serrated scythe-limbs; chill them with frost.
unlock_hint: Cross Bracken Basin in Act II.

title: Basalt Brute
body: Walking siege-engines of hexagonal black rock animated by caldera pressure. Immobilize their wide feet with ice magic and chip them down from range.
unlock_hint: Face a Basalt Brute in Act II.

title: Crypt Embalmer
body: Third-Dynasty mortuary priests whose hollowed ribs house venomous copperheads. Burn them from afar before their bitumen fumes rot wounds.
unlock_hint: Enter the lower quarry gallery in m20.

title: Salt Crab
body: Tidal crustaceans that cement brine-crystals and wrecked hull planks onto their shells. Flank their massive left shield-claw or boil them with lightning.
unlock_hint: Wade the low-tide flats in m28.

title: Elder Juggernaut
body: Colossal bedrock constructs bound during the Age of Chains (see cdx-age-of-chains). Conventional steel bounces off; target glowing rune-seams with arcane fire.
unlock_hint: Defeat the ridge sentinel in m32.

title: Frost Bell
body: Levitating liturgical bronze bells torn from drowned chapels. Their skull-clappers ring sub-audible chimes that freeze mana and crack mortar.
unlock_hint: Shatter a Frost Bell in Act III.

title: Night Orchard
body: Gallows-trees animated by shadow covens, bearing screaming magenta skulls like winter fruit. Chop them down with fire-enchanted axes.
unlock_hint: Clear the terraced grove in Act III.

title: Anvilmaw Smith
body: Cinderforge siege-titans with iron anvils for lower jaws and smoking chimneys on their spines. Scatter when they raise their hammer-arms toward their chins.
unlock_hint: Hunt an Anvilmaw in Act IV.

title: Redglass Drake
body: Volcanic ridge dragons with razor-sharp obsidian wing-membranes. Ground them with cold magic and stay clear of their molten glass breath.
unlock_hint: Spot a Redglass Drake in Act IV.

title: Massacre at Sunken Ford
body: Grok'tar's gnoll warband butchered the Thornwick night-watch at dawn, torching the tollhouse to hide forged Border Mint dispatches.
unlock_hint: Complete m01-blood-at-the-ford.

title: The Broken Picket
body: Four watchmen abandoned Ravenwatch's outer wall before nightfall, pulling the iron stakes from inside to lure defenders away from the Sunken Sanctum.
unlock_hint: Complete m03-nightfall-at-ravenwatch.

title: The Alder Bridge Stand
body: Three thousand river-parish refugees crossed Alder Bridge under arrow cover while pikemen held three successive raider waves on the slick oak planks.
unlock_hint: Complete m08-alder-bridge.

title: The Burning of Ashbrook
body: Unable to hold shattered timber gates against Velen's rams, the vanguard sallied out to slay the commander and escort survivors south into Redmarsh.
unlock_hint: Complete Act I.

title: The Wardstone Rupture
body: Ashen Coven sorcerers cracked three quartz wardstones to test sigil-breaking rituals, unleashing scouring copper dust storms across Bracken Basin.
unlock_hint: Complete m16-wardstone-rupture.

title: The Deep Quarry Revolt
body: Chained ironstone miners broke their pens with stolen picks during the vanguard assault, flooding the pit and starving Gorrathul's forges of ore.
unlock_hint: Complete m20-deep-quarry.

title: The Lie of Ironheart
body: Gorrathul bled two thousand men defending Ironheart's forked cisterns, only for victors to discover the lower aquifers had silted dry years earlier.
unlock_hint: Complete Act II.

title: The Oakhaven Truce
body: After mercenaries cleared the channel blockade, Oakhaven's council opened its armories and pledged coastal marines for the southern crossing.
unlock_hint: Complete m24-pledge-at-oakhaven.

title: The Burning of Harborwatch
body: Admiral Vesperion torched drydocks and fishing sloops to deny troop transports, losing his flagship when reclaimed seawall guns shattered his rudder.
unlock_hint: Complete Act III.

title: Flight of Arch-Mage Malrik
body: Malrik fled Ironcamp with stolen cipher-keys and leyline codices, dying on the summit portal stairs before he could seal the inner sanctum.
unlock_hint: Complete m39-flight-of-malrik.

title: Battle of Three-Roads Watch
body: Three converging relief armies were defeated in detail across the ash plains, isolating the Infernal Citadel behind its magma moats.
unlock_hint: Complete m43-three-roads-siege.

title: The Threshold Reckoning
body: At the geometric heart of the caldera, the last Anchor Seals fractured—forcing Thornvael's liberators to choose between pale starlight and living ember.
unlock_hint: Complete Act IV.
